name: editQualificationDetails
description:
This tool updates existing qualification records in the Qualifications module. It safely searches by qualification code or the name, opens the record, enters edit mode, and applies only the fields explicitly provided. 
Unchanged fields are preserved to prevent accidental data loss.
The user must provide either the code OR the name for each dropdown field (not both).
At least one update field must be provided along with one identification field.

args.name: qualificationCode
args.description: he unique code identifier for the qualification to update (e.g., '000005')

args.name: qualificationName
args.description: The current name of the qualification to search for and then to update (e.g., "Junior Prefect")

args.name: newQualificationName
args.description: The new name for the qualification (e.g., "Junior Prefect 2018/2019")

args.name: ratingMethodCode
args.description: The rating method code to assign (e.g., "000001")

args.name: ratingMethodName
args.description: The rating method name to assign, alternative to ratingMethodCode (e.g., "Rating_01")

args.name: qualificationTypeCode
args.description: The qualification type code to assign (e.g., "000008")

args.name: qualificationTypeName
args.description: The qualification type name to assign, alternative to qualificationTypeCode (e.g., "leadership roles")

args.name: classificationCode
args.description: The classification code to assign (e.g., "000006")

args.name: classificationName
args.description: The classification name to assign, alternative to classificationCode (e.g., "Soft skills / Short term qualifications")

args.name: hasExpiration
args.description: Set expiration status, accepts string "true" or "false" (e.g., "true")
